questions.title: Energy Shield, Chaos 2x Loss, Bleed/Poison Bypass & CI Immunity
questions.question: In Path of Exile 2 Patch 0.5.5: (a) Does non-poison Chaos hit damage bypass Energy Shield, or how does it interact with Energy Shield? (b) Do Bleeding and Poison bypass Energy Shield? (c) Does a 1-Life Chaos Inoculation (CI) character die instantly to Bleeding?
poe2brain_commands: uv run poe2 wiki mechanic "energy shield" --json
uv run poe2 wiki mechanic "chaos inoculation" --json
questions.ground_truth_summary: Non-poison Chaos hit damage does NOT bypass Energy Shield — it removes 2x (twice) as much Energy Shield. Both Bleeding and Poison bypass Energy Shield to damage Life directly. Chaos Inoculation sets Maximum Life to 1 and grants immunity to BOTH Chaos damage AND Bleeding, so a CI character does NOT die to Bleeding.

checks.label: Chaos hit damage hits ES first (does not bypass) and removes 2x ES
Both Bleeding and Poison bypass Energy Shield
CI grants immunity to both Chaos and Bleeding

hallucination_traps.label: Claimed Chaos hit damage bypasses Energy Shield (PoE1 rule)
Claimed Bleeding kills a 1-Life CI character

Glancing Blows has nothing to do with Block: it makes Chance to Evade Unlucky and Chance to Deflect Lucky. Deflection replaced Spell Suppression on Dexterity gear, mitigating 40% of hit damage by default with a 95% Deflect chance cap.

checks.label: Base passive Block cap is 50%
Glancing Blows makes Evade Unlucky and Deflect Lucky
Deflection prevents 40% damage and caps at 95% chance

hallucination_traps.label: Claimed base maximum Block chance is 75% (PoE1 / stale 0.1 rule)
Claimed Glancing Blows doubles Block chance / takes 65% damage (PoE1)

questions.title: Damage Conversion Scaling, Multiplicative Quality & Base Crit Bonus
questions.question: In PoE2 Patch 0.5.5: (a) If a skill converts 100% of Physical damage to Lightning, how much does global '% increased Physical Damage' on the passive tree scale that converted Lightning damage? (b) Is +20% Quality on a Martial Weapon additive with local '% increased Physical Damage' or multiplicative (MORE)? poe2brain_commands: uv run poe2 wiki mechanic "conversion" --json

questions.ground_truth_summary: (a) Global '% increased Physical Damage' gives 0% scaling to converted Lightning damage — converted damage scales only with final target damage type modifiers. (b) Weapon Quality is multiplicative (1% MORE Physical Damage per 1% Quality, 1.20x at 20%), NOT additive. (c) Player inherent base Critical Hit Damage Bonus is +100% (2.0x / 200% total damage on crit).

checks.label: Global % Physical grants 0% to converted Lightning damage
Martial Weapon Quality is multiplicative (MORE, 1.20x at 20%)
Player base Critical Hit Damage Bonus is +100% (2.0x / 200%)

Claimed weapon Quality is additive with local % Physical (PoE1)

questions.title: Compiled <=50-Char Waystone Juicing Regex (120%/20%) & Max-Res Math
questions.question: For PoE2 0.5.5 Waystone rolling: (a) Compile a single PoE2 stash regex (strictly <= 50 characters including quotes) that matches Waystones with `>= 120%` Waystone Drop Chance (including `+1000%`) OR `>= 20%` Pack Size (including `+100%`), while rejecting `+119%` Waystone Drop Chance and `+19%` Pack Size; provide the exact regex in backticks and its character length. (b) At 75% Elemental Resistance, by what % range does a `-3%` to `-8%` maximum Player Resistances modifier increase elemental damage taken?
poe2brain_commands: uv run poe2 wiki regex --archetype es_ci --min-waystone-drop 120 --min-pack-size 20 --json
questions.ground_truth_summary: (a) Juicing regex: `"ce:..(1[2-9]|[2-9]\d|\d{3})\d|ze:..([2-9]|1\d)\d"` (50 characters, strictly <= 50-char limit; matches +120%/+1000% drop and +20%/+100% pack size; rejects +119% and +19%). (b) At 75% elemental resistance, -3% to -8% max res increases elemental damage taken by 12% to 32%.

checks.label: Valid <=50-char PoE2 juicing regex matching 120%/1000% drop & 20%/100% pack, rejecting 119%/19%
Reports 12% to 32% more elemental damage taken
